description_en: Sends a voice verification code and voice notification with variables to a phone number
description_zh: 向指定号码发送语音验证码和带参数变量的语音通知
kebab_example: aliyun dyvmsapi-intl backend-call-signal --called-number 85200000000 --caller-id-number 85200000000 --country-id HK --play-times 2 --speed 0 --tts-code 1001 --tts-param code_:_1234 --volume 100 --out-id 225220000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BackendCallSignal

parameters.help_en:
The phone number that receives the voice notification.

You must add the country code to the beginning of the phone number. Example: 85200\\00
parameters.help_zh:
接收语音通知的手机号码。

号码格式：国际码+号码：
示例：85200****00
parameters.name: called_number

parameters.help_en:
The calling number.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses a local random number as the display number. If you use a dedicated number for outbound calls, you must specify the purchased number. You can specify only one number. You can log on to the VMS console and choose Number Management to view the purchased phone numbers
parameters.help_zh:
主叫号码。

若您不填该参数，系统将会使用当地随机号码作为外显号码。
若您专属号码外呼，则必须传入已购买的号码，仅支持一个号码。您可以登录国际语音服务控制台，选择"号码管理"查看已购买的号码
parameters.name: caller_id_number

parameters.help_en: The number of times the voice notification is played back in a call. Valid values: 1 to 3. Default value: 3
parameters.help_zh: 一通电话内语音通知内容的播放次数。取值范围：1~3，默认取值3
parameters.name: play_times

parameters.help_en: The playback speed. Valid values: -500 to 500
parameters.name: speed

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the approved voice verification code template.

You can log on to the VMS console and choose Voice Call Template to view the template ID
parameters.help_zh:
已通过审核的语音验证码模板ID。

您可以登录国际语音服务控制台，选择"国际语音-语音模板管理-文本转语音模板"查看模板ID
parameters.name: tts_code

parameters.help_en: The variables in the template, in the JSON format
parameters.help_zh: 模板中的变量参数，JSON格式
parameters.name: tts_param

parameters.help_en: The playback volume of the voice notification. Valid values: 0 to 100. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 语音通知的播放音量。取值范围：0~100，默认取值100
parameters.name: volume

parameters.help_en:
The ID reserved for the caller. This ID is returned to the caller in a receipt message.

The value must be of the STRING type and 1 to 15 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh:
预留给调用方使用的ID，最终会通过在回执消息中将此ID带回给调用方。

字符串类型，长度为1~15个字节
parameters.name: out_id

CallId.description_en: The unique receipt ID for the call. You can use this ID to query the details of a single call
CallId.description_zh: 此次通话的唯一回执ID。可以通过此ID查询单个通话的详情

Code.description_en:
The response code.

The value OK indicates that the request was successful. Other values indicate that the request failed. For more information, see Error codes
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。

返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见API错误码
